note: CB-D4/D5/D6: an unnamed extension on a type this file does not declare (an import-prefixed type, a core type) is skipped (members.unnamed_ext_skipped); a top-level initialiser's calls are never walked and a `var` list is not read; collect_import keeps the raw text after `import `, so `import 'money.dart' as m show Money, round2;` resolves nothing. DECISION: an unnamed extension on a type declared elsewhere is its own CLASS container `<module>::extension<T>` (T the on-type's simple name, prefix and type arguments dropped), its members METHODs under it; a top-level initialiser's calls come FROM its STATE_VAR.
